confirmed_findings.defect: The claim that algebraic A-homology surjects onto completed Hilbert reduced homology conflates pA^n with pℓ²(G)^n. These are not the same algebraic module. The actual projection construction in1.1 surjects onto pA^n, while its natural map to pℓ² has only dense image.
confirmed_findings.counterexample: Take G=Z, A≅L∞(T), and compact oriented CP2 with trivial regular local coefficient monodromy. The degree2 differential is zero; H2(A)=A maps naturally to completed reduced H2=L²(T). An unbounded L² function such as |theta|^(-1/4) near0 is not in L∞, proving failure of surjectivity.
